author_room.name: Layer E Author Room

agents.claim: The story is not the list of activities; the story is wanting a life where ordinary things repeat with one person.
agents.objection: If the visuals only decorate the copied text, the deck becomes generic.
agents.recommendation: Make every wish a physical scene with action, object movement, and consequence.

agents.claim: The selected visual system can be A Story-specific even with faceless frames.
agents.objection: Exact third-party text must be treated as draft unless rights are cleared.
agents.recommendation: Proceed to visual plan and proof with a copy-rights note; use rewrite options for public version if needed.

author_room.summary: The route passes because it turns wish-list romance into staged ordinary-life behavior while preserving A Story visual ownership.
debate_records: Keep exact visible text only as draft until rights are cleared.
Reject screenshot recreation and quote-card layout.
Use faceless/cropped identity continuity as the creative constraint.

exploration_routes.name: Little Futures, Mostly Faceless
exploration_routes.story_lens: Ordinary future wishes become proof of wanting a shared life.
exploration_routes.reader_mirror: People do not only want grand romance; they want Sundays, errands, dinners, and private noticing with their person.
exploration_routes.emotional_obstacle: A poetic wish list can feel generic unless the scene proves a specific relationship.
exploration_routes.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu is present through expressive hand cues, jewelry, hair silhouette, the objects Zuv notices for her, and the softness of their shared domestic world.
exploration_routes.zuv_active_role: Zuv drives, serves, notices, chooses, and helps collect the moments instead of simply standing beside the copy.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: Hands, mugs, dessert spoons, grocery tote, balcony dinner, shop object, and memory pile turn text into visible behavior.
exploration_routes.emotional_reversal: The fantasy stops being cinematic and becomes ordinary enough to believe.
exploration_routes.payoff: The moments were being collected all along so they could be shared with each other.
exploration_routes.distribution_reason: Viewers can send it to a partner as a soft, specific list of ordinary futures they want together.

stage_scene_gate.action: Each slide stages a concrete physical action connected to the line.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: Hands, posture, and object focus show desire or response.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: Attention moves toward the shared object, hand, food, road, or memory pile.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: Holding, serving, choosing, saving, and collecting are visible.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: Clean negative space and soft pauses match the reference's quiet romance.
stage_scene_gate.consequence: The viewer understands the relationship beat without needing faces on every slide.
stage_scene_gate.reversal_or_payoff: The final slide reveals the whole list as a private archive of small proofs.

rejected_routes.distribution_reason: Weak because it is not ownable.
